_meta.description: Mock certification-body registry standing in for real lookups against issuing bodies (e.g. IAF CertSearch for ISO 27001, AICPA for SOC 2, UAE TDRA/Signal & Collaboration Authority for UAE Information Assurance). In production this module would query those registries' APIs/search portals instead of a static file.
_meta.schema: domain -> list of {standard, status, issuer, valid_from, valid_until, certificate_id}
